notes: Metropolitan Council Transportation System Performance Evaluation (TSPE) report, Figure 8.1/8.2 (metrocouncil.org), all-bus on-time performance -- departs 1 min early to 5 min late at scheduled timepoints. Bus chosen as the primary series (not light rail) since it carries the large majority of Metro Transit ridership; a separately-tracked all-LRT OTP series also exists (2019: 84.6%) and is a documented alternative, not blended in. This report itself only covers '2019 to present' -- no OTP series exists before 2019, a confirmed structural start date, not a search failure.
